description.text: The fourth expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released on 18 September 2020 and led by Pikachu VMAX, Pikachu in its Gigantamax form, whose attack does 270 damage by discarding all its Energy. Orbeetle VMAX, whose Ability puts damage counters on all the opponent's Pokémon, Galarian Darmanitan VMAX and Aegislash VMAX join it, and some Pokémon have attacks that combine with a Supporter, such as Charizard with Leon, Drednaw with Nessa and Hitmontop with Bea. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 100, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters, and gold Ultra Rare Galarian Obstagoon, Telescopic Sight and Memory Capsule. In English most of its cards came out in Vivid Voltage in November 2020.
